verses.text: The word of the LORD came to me:

"Go and announce this so that Jerusalem hears it: This is what the LORD says: 'I remember how faithful you were when you were young, how you loved me like a bride. You followed me through the wilderness, through a land where nothing was planted.
Israel was holy to the LORD, the first part of his harvest. All who tried to eat it up were found guilty, and disaster came on them,'" says the LORD.
Listen to the word of the LORD, people of Jacob, all you families of Israel!
This is what the LORD says: "What wrong did your ancestors find in me, that they went so far away from me? They followed worthless idols and became worthless themselves.

They did not ask, 'Where is the LORD, who brought us up out of Egypt, who led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and pits, a land of drought and deep darkness, a land no one travels through and where no one lives?'
I brought you into a fertile land to eat its fruit and its good things. But when you came in, you made my land unclean, and you made my inheritance disgusting.
The priests did not ask, 'Where is the LORD?' Those who taught the law did not know me. The leaders rebelled against me. The prophets prophesied by Baal and followed worthless idols.
So I will bring charges against you again," says the LORD. "And I will bring charges against your children's children.
Go across to the coasts of Cyprus and look. Send someone to Kedar and look carefully. See if anything like this has ever happened.
Has any nation ever changed its gods, even though they are not really gods? But my people have traded their glorious God for worthless idols.
Be shocked at this, you heavens! Shake with horror and be completely dismayed," says the LORD.
"For my people have done two evil things: they have left me, the spring of living water, and they have dug their own wells, broken wells that cannot hold water.
Is Israel a slave? Was he born a servant? Then why has he been taken as plunder?
Lions have roared at him. They have growled loudly. They have ruined his land. His towns are burned and empty, with no one living in them.
Even the people of Memphis and Tahpanhes have shaved your head in shame.
Have you not brought this on yourself by leaving the LORD your God when he led you on the way?
Now why go to Egypt to drink water from the Nile? Why go to Assyria to drink water from the Euphrates River?

Your own evil will punish you, and your turning away will correct you. So understand and see how evil and bitter it is to leave the LORD your God and to have no respect for me," says the Lord GOD of Armies.
"Long ago you broke your yoke and tore off your chains. You said, 'I will not serve you!' Instead, on every high hill and under every green tree, you lay down like a prostitute.
I planted you like a choice vine, from the very best seed. How then did you turn against me and become a wild, worthless vine?
Even if you wash yourself with strong soap and use lots of cleaning powder, the stain of your sin is still before me," says the Lord GOD.
"How can you say, 'I am not unclean. I have not followed the Baals'? Look at what you did in the valley. Think about what you have done. You are like a young female camel running here and there,

like a wild donkey used to the wilderness, sniffing the wind in her desire. Who can hold her back when she is in heat? The males that look for her do not need to tire themselves out. At mating time they will find her.
Do not run until your feet are bare and your throat is dry. But you said, 'It is no use! I love foreign gods, and I will follow them.'
As a thief is ashamed when he is caught, so the people of Israel are ashamed, they, their kings, their officials, their priests, and their prophets.

They say to a piece of wood, 'You are my father,' and to a stone, 'You gave birth to me.' They have turned their backs to me and not their faces. Yet when they are in trouble, they say, 'Come and save us!'
But where are the gods you made for yourselves? Let them come and save you when you are in trouble! For you have as many gods as you have towns, Judah.
Why do you bring charges against me? All of you have rebelled against me," says the LORD.
"I punished your children, but it did no good. They would not accept correction. Your own sword has killed your prophets like a hungry lion.

You people of this generation, pay attention to the word of the LORD: Have I been like a wilderness to Israel, or a land of deep darkness? Why do my people say, 'We are free to wander. We will not come to you anymore'?
Does a young woman forget her jewelry, or a bride her wedding dress? Yet my people have forgotten me for more days than can be counted.
How skilled you are at chasing after love! Even the worst women could learn from your ways.
On your clothes is found the blood of innocent poor people, though you did not catch them breaking in. Yet in spite of all this,
you say, 'I am innocent. Surely he is not angry with me.' But I will judge you, because you say, 'I have not sinned.'
Why do you keep changing your mind so easily? You will be let down by Egypt, just as you were let down by Assyria.
You will also leave that place with your hands on your head in shame. For the LORD has rejected those you trust, and you will not succeed with their help."
